# Nectisse 0.1.0

The first release of Nectisse. Look up works, save their metadata and covers, browse your collection as a fullscreen cover wall, and follow performer releases and creator updates in one place.

- Search by work ID, title keywords, or a supported source URL, and compare metadata across sources.
- Configure metadata precedence and cover-source priority separately, with DMM / FANZA covers preferred by default.
- Keep a local collection with search, sorting, and offline access to saved metadata and covers.
- Explore a fullscreen cover collage with dragging, zooming, search, full-resolution previews, and access to work details.
- Look up and follow performers and creators, check updates manually or on a schedule, and upload custom profile pictures.
- Browse performer releases with pagination and creator posts in an image-aware masonry layout, ordered by publication time.
- Search Sukebei and JavTao from a work's detail view, copy magnet links, or open the original listing.
- Retain metadata and post summaries long-term. The ordinary image cache defaults to 512 MiB, with an adjustable limit and manual cleanup.
- Choose between Cream Archive and Blackberry Night themes, with settings for sources, subscriptions, proxies, and diagnostics.

Supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. The Python runtime is bundled with the app; no developer tools are required. Available fields, access permissions, and update coverage vary by source. See the in-app notes for details.

Download the DMG and drag Nectisse into **Applications**, or download the ZIP and extract the app. Use `SHA256SUMS` to verify the integrity of either package.
